bindings.caption: Figures13–14 compare distinct ligand titrations; no numerical curve digitization or fixed reaction feed inferred. Source describes all porphyrins as quenching; nonporphyrinic acid11 serves as control. Instrument: PerkinElmer LS55 spectrofluorimeter (main p.11). Figures13/14 captions refer to porphyrins1–10, but neither plotted legend identifies9. The main source does not resolve whether9 was separately plotted or whether any such sample was protected thioacetate or deprotected thiol. No definite9 optical sample is assigned. general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
